headline: Regis end Seattle Pacific's winning run
dek: Seattle Pacific had won every match since their October defeat at Western Oregon, until Regis came to their ground and won. It is only their fourth defeat of the season.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Saint Martin's 32 goals are more than Simon Fraser, Western Washington or Northwest Nazarene have scored, yet they sit bottom of the table: most of their goals have come against sides outside the conference, not in the matches the table counts.

wire.line: Seattle Pacific have won seventeen matches, more than any other programme, yet sit behind Western Oregon in the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches whose dates have passed carry no result, and every one of them is a Simon Fraser home match from August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Archie Dhima has nineteen goals from 64 shots for Western Oregon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Juan Diaz has nine assists for Saint Martin's.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Elijah Brockl has kept seven shutouts for Northwest Nazarene.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Of the shots on target Austin Valdez has faced for Western Oregon, 105 were saved and 30 went in.

last_match.line: Western Oregon still top the conference table, and within it only Seattle Pacific have beaten them.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
